title: psychotria leptothyrsa var. multifurca
intro: Psychotria leptothyrsa var. multifurca, commonly known as the multifurcate wild coffee, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The multifurcate wild coffee has been reported to possess analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, attributed to its therapeutic actions in relieving pain, reducing inflammation, and combating infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, such as cafisetin and cafsetin glycoside, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
